title: CPF Module Schema: Log Analytics Workspace module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-loganalyticsworkspace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

allow_resource_only_permissions.description: (Optional) The resource permissions log for the Log Analytics workspace.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_for_query_forced.description: (Optional) The cmk_for_query_forced for the Log Analytics workspace.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

daily_quota_gb.description: (Optional) The daily quota in GB for the Log Analytics workspace.

data_classification_tag_value.description: (Optional) The value of the data classification tag required by policy.

data_collection_rule_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Data Collection Rule to use for this workspace.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the identity type of the Log Analytics Workspace. Possible values are SystemAssigned (where Azure will generate a Service Principal for you) and UserAssigned where you can specify the Service Principal IDs in the identity_ids field" identity_ids = " (Optional) Specifies a list of user managed identity ids to be assigned. Required if type is UserAssigned" })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

internet_ingestion_enabled.description: (Optional) The internet ingestion enabled for the Log Analytics workspace.

internet_query_enabled.description: (Optional) The internet query enabled for the Log Analytics workspace.

local_authentication_disabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether to disable local authentication for the Log Analytics workspace. When set to true, enforces Azure AD (Entra ID) authentication only.

log_analytics_custom_tables.type: map(object({ description = optional(string, null) restoredLogs = optional(object({ endRestoreTime = string sourceTable = string startRestoreTime = string }), null) columns = list(object({ name = string displayName = string type = string description = optional(string, null) dataTypeHint = optional(string, null) })) searchResults = optional(object({ description = string endSearchTime = string limit = number query = string startSearchTime = string }), null) retention_in_days = optional(number, 365) total_retention_days = optional(number, 365) plan = string }))
log_analytics_custom_tables.description: (Optional) A map of custom tables to create in the Log Analytics workspace. map(object({ description = "(Optional) Description of the custom table's purpose and usage." restoredLogs = Optional(object({ endRestoreTime = "(Required) The timestamp to end the restore by (UTC)." sourceTable = "(Required) The table to restore data from." startRestoreTime = "(Required) The timestamp to start the restore from (UTC)." })) columns = (Required)list(object({ name = "(Required) The name of the column." displayName = "(Required) The display name of the column." type = "(Required) The data type of the column (e.g., 'string', 'datetime', 'int', 'real', 'boolean', 'guid', 'dynamic')." description = "(Optional) Description of the column's purpose." dataTypeHint = "(Optional) Column data type logical hint. Valid values: 'armPath', 'guid', 'ip', 'uri'." })) searchResults = Optional(object({ description = "(Required) Description of the search results configuration." endSearchTime = "(Required) The end time for search results in ISO 8601 format." limit = "(Required) The maximum number of search results to return." query = "(Required) The KQL query to execute for search results." startSearchTime = "(Required) The start time for search results in ISO 8601 format." })) })) retention_in_days = "(Optional) The table retention period in days (4-4383, or -1 for default)." total_retention_days = "(Optional) The total retention period in days (4-4383, or -1 for default)." plan = "(Required) The table plan type. Valid values: 'Analytics', 'Basic'." }))

log_analytics_data_export.type: object({ name = string table_names = list(string) destination_resource_id = string enabled = optional(bool) })
log_analytics_data_export.description: (Optional) object({ name = (Required) The name of the Log Analytics Data Export Rule. Changing this forces a new Log Analytics Data Export Rule to be created. table_names = (Required) A list of table names to export to the destination resource, for example: ["Heartbeat", "SecurityEvent"]. destination_resource_id = (Required) The destination resource ID. It should be a storage account, an event hub namespace or an event hub. If the destination is an event hub namespace, an event hub would be created for each table automatically. enabled = (Optional) Is this Log Analytics Data Export Rule enabled? Possible values include true or false. Defaults to false. })

reservation_capacity_in_gb_per_day.description: (Optional) The reservation capacity in GB per day for the Log Analytics workspace.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

retention_in_days.description: (Optional) The retention in days for the Log Analytics workspace.

sku.description: (Optional) The SKU for the Log Analytics workspace.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

export_rule_id.description: The resource ID of the created Data Export Rule.

export_rule_name.description: The name of the created Data Export Rule.

id.description: The resource ID of the Log Analytics Workspace. If a new Log Analytics Workspace is created, fetch its data id, if one is created, fetch the remote one instead.

log_analytics_data_id.description: The resource ID of the Log Analytics Data Export Rule.

log_analytics_data_resource.description: The Log Analytics Data Export Rule resource.

name.description: The name of the Log Analytics Workspace.

workspace_id.description: The Workspace (or Customer) ID for the Log Analytics Workspace.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Loganalyticsworkspace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
